description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
If Fatestitcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
If Forensic Researcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Fatestitcher or Forensic Researcher
